answer: Each identity locks a 68-credit bond and buys one hollow walnut capsule keyed to its own key. The capsule is dropped into a public tank and must rest at the nadir line, where a depth gauge records its serial and depth for all to see. The first sinking fee is 29 credits; the k-th identity pays 29+4(k-1), so the 1000th pays 4025, and 1000 fakes pay 2,027,000 in fees plus 68,000 locked. A rented-capsule ring fails because a reused serial is rejected at the gauge and its bond burns. An honest agent pays 97 once.
